description: Case creation rule library for the Case Management onboarding solution. Each entry is the input of case_rule_apply (action create); {{PREFIX}} is replaced with the deployment prefix. Expressions use the short form; ids are generated. Every expression was validated with validateRuleExpression on a live console.

rules.name: {{PREFIX}} Critical alerts
rules.description: One case per affected asset for every critical alert.
defaultTasks: Confirm the detection with threat intelligence
Contain the affected asset if confirmed

rules.name: {{PREFIX}} Ransomware
rules.description: Alerts classified as ransomware, grouped per asset.
defaultTasks: Check mapped and network drives for encryption
Hunt for the same hash and storyline on other assets

rules.name: {{PREFIX}} Credential access
rules.description: Credential access (TA0006) at medium severity or above, grouped per user and asset.
defaultTasks: Reset the affected account credentials if confirmed

rules.name: {{PREFIX}} Lateral movement
defaultTasks: Map every host the account reached
Check for credential theft on the source host

rules.name: {{PREFIX}} Command and control
rules.description: Command and control (TA0011), grouped per asset and remote IP.
defaultTasks: Enrich the remote IPs and domains
Block confirmed infrastructure at the perimeter

rules.name: {{PREFIX}} Exfiltration or impact
rules.description: Exfiltration (TA0010) or impact (TA0040), grouped per asset.
defaultTasks: Scope the data or systems affected
